# netskopebwan_qosmos_app (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated from the provider's schema: the arguments this object requires, with
# placeholders to fill in. Remove these two lines to maintain the example by hand.
# A single object is addressed either by its id...
data "netskopebwan_qosmos_app" "by_id" {
  id = "6501f0c2e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6"
}

# ...or by a filter, which has to match exactly one object.
data "netskopebwan_qosmos_app" "by_filter" {
  filter = "name eq \"example\""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Filter selecting the object to read, in the API's filter syntax, e.g. `name eq "corporate"`. It has to match exactly one object. Exactly one of `id` or `filter` is required.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object to read. Exactly one of `id` or `filter` is required.

### Read-Only

- `category` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--category))
- `name` (String) Application name e.g. "Base virtual protocol"
- `qosmos_id` (Number) Qosmos identifier e.g. 3
